fact: The Annuaire statistique 2024, dated April 2025, states that the 2024 activity reports of public and private health facilities and of CHR/CHU units were keyed into Endos-BF by the infirmiers chefs de poste, by the districts' CISSE and by the hospitals' SPIH/SIM, and gives a completeness of entry of 85.4% and a promptitude of 71.7% for 2024, against 91.8% and 77.0% in 2023; it gives no count of facilities keying their own reports.
title: Annuaire statistique 2024
publisher: Ministère de la Santé, Direction générale des études et des statistiques sectorielles
